description: This file declares functions for launching CUDA kernels related to grid sampling operations in PyTorch, specifically for 2D and 3D grid sampling and their backward passes.

methods.name: launch_grid_sampler_2d_forward_kernel
methods.description: Launches a CUDA kernel for the forward pass of 2D grid sampling.

methods.name: launch_grid_sampler_3d_forward_kernel
methods.description: Launches a CUDA kernel for the forward pass of 3D grid sampling.

methods.name: launch_grid_sampler_2d_backward_kernel
methods.description: Launches a CUDA kernel for the backward pass (gradients) of 2D grid sampling.

methods.name: launch_grid_sampler_3d_backward_kernel
methods.description: Launches a CUDA kernel for the backward pass (gradients) of 3D grid sampling.
